description: Call this before you commit to any SaaS, API, MCP server or CLI you found or already have in mind: send its slug from search_tools, or its name or domain (unknown: an error naming the closest). It returns the product's test-drive result, how far an agent gets with it and where it stops (13 to 35 KB; brief: true, the headline in 2.5 to 5 KB). The full result: the agent level, the five outcomes (find, shown as Learn; access, use, pay, leave, by any way in the product offers; stages: the four that decide the level, under their older keys), how an agent gets in (access, with the core tasks done on each way), the part scores, the nine checkpoints from docs to delete, what an agent can and cannot do, tips for agents, pay_options (the ways an agent can pay, the payment we proved with its transaction, what the owner could add), the bot check that stopped our agent on a way in (agent_check: vendor, step, type network or challenge, the owner's fix), after_wall and works_assisted (what it did once a person helped: not counted), robots (a robots.txt rule on the way in; held: the level is from the last drive past it), same_level_drives, confirmation (do the drives agree), the level history and why each move happened (product, agent, rules, noise), rules_date (the rules the level was set by), audited: its certificate, if any. agent_surfaces (api, mcp, cli, sdk, docs, payment: tested, documented, none_found or unknown; get_agent_surfaces adds where and when) and issues_found (a count; the detail is the owner's). Also routes (every way in and what happened on each), checkout (how far toward the last click), docs (read and judged) and claims (the documented ways to do the core work, tried once each: held, broken, worked but undocumented). newer_drives (drives after the listed one, not listed yet); attempts_count; the attempt log with its evidence is detail.url, for the product's verified owner. Every field: https://agentdrives.com/openapi.json (Tool).
